exposure: combined intravaginal misoprostol and intracervical Foley catheter
cohort: 60 pregnant females between 14 and 20 weeks of gestation admitted for termination of pregnancy.
finding: Combined use of intravaginal misoprostol and intracervical Foley catheter significantly reduced the duration of induction to abortion, total dose of misoprostol required, and hospital stay compared to intravaginal misoprostol alone for mid-trimester pregnancy termination.
